Package io Description

Provides classes and interfaces for creating and manipulating spreadsheet files, supporting Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice Calc, and CSV formats.

This package includes high-performance solutions designed to overcome memory limitations typical of standard processing, such as SAX-based event readers for streaming large datasets with minimal memory overhead, as well as specialised tabular writers including ExcelWritable and WriteCSV.
